Two sites, one process. This page runs on port 8080 (public site). Port 8081 is a separate virtual site protected by Basic Auth — both share the same Conduit process configured in demo/conduit.json. The API proxy round-robins across two backend instances on ports 4000 and 4001.

Admin API

Conduit's management API runs on 127.0.0.1:2019 (loopback only). Use the CLI to inspect and control the running process: 

conduit status          # uptime, version, inflight requests
conduit upstreams       # health and latency of all backends
conduit upstreams add --route /api --target http://localhost:4002
                        # add a third backend — no restart needed
conduit reload          # reload config from disk — no restart
conduit shutdown        # graceful shutdown
